lifecycle_gate.historical_gate_statement: D4 requires the D3.5 bridge validated by A2; D3.5-A2 alone validated the replacement.
lifecycle_gate.evidence_basis: D3_COMPLETE + D3_5_SELECTIVITY_VALIDATED + D3_5_A6_DOWNSTREAM_ADMISSION_VALIDATED. Historical D3.5-A2 observed the structured bridge mechanism at candidate-pool level (+0.3 combined candidate recall), but produced zero incremental final-evidence recovery due to downstream cutoff. D3.5-A5-R2 repaired and validated deterministic candidate selectivity (v2 policy, 4/8 caps, relevant evidence retained). D3.5-A6 Phase 2 validated bounded reserved rerank admission (K=3) at downstream final-evidence level under Gemini 3.8 Flash, achieving CAUSAL_DELTA_3 = 2 (3/3 stable reserved witness on g036.e1 and g021.e1) with REGRESSION_3 = 0 across 5 safety groups. Validated for bounded development migration only; PRODUCTION_ACTIVATION remains false.

batch1.selection_rationale: These two rules represent the complete set of legacy-dependent rules with confirmed downstream structured replacement validity (D3 legacy dependency confirmed; D3.5-A5-R2 selectivity validated; D3.5-A6 Phase 2 K=3 bounded rerank admission validated).
batch1.experimental_focus: Isolates the fixed-location dependency (file paths, source paths, macros, and paper-page hints) of the two demonstrated legacy-dependent rules, replacing them with the generic structured path while preserving domain terminology, scope, and concepts.

overlap_accounting.audit_scope: All 54 current query-expansion rules audited for potential locator overlap with Batch-1 targets.

overlap_accounting.future_treatment_mask_policy: If an equivalent locator rule is activated on any future migration case, D4-A1 must apply TREATMENT_MASK_EQUIVALENT_LOCATOR_ON_TARGET_CASE to suppress that locator on the target case to preserve causal identifiability.

replacement_contract.d1_d2_authority: D2 governed resolution -> D1 accepted objects/relations/workflows. No fuzzy/dense/LLM jumping.
replacement_contract.bridge_semantics: Bounded reachability: max 1 upward containment transition + max 1 predicate/type-gated relation/workflow transition. Governed provenance materialization to exact source/version evidence.
prohibited_shortcuts: No new scorer, weights, or reranker models
No benchmark-specific mapping tables or ID lookup dicts
No silent re-injection of suppressed legacy locators into retrieval channels

replacement_supported_conditions: 1. LEGACY_CONTROL demonstrates expected useful evidence behavior (final evidence retention > 0)
2. BATCH1_ABLATION loses or materially weakens the evidence attributable to the migrated fixed locators
3. BATCH1_REPLACEMENT restores the required evidence to the frozen acceptance target
4. Recovery is causally attributable to the generic structured path with reserved witness, not an equivalent shortcut
5. Zero material control regressions across safety population (REGRESSION == 0)

n022.description: Diagnostic and non-gating only. Evaluated to observe non-trigger paraphrase behavior and potential structured generalization; does not gate Batch-1 replacement PASS/FAIL.

future_D4_A1.attribution_requirements: The replacement arm must not silently reuse suppressed fixed locators. Evaluation receipts must prove full chain: legacy fixed locator suppressed -> structured seed resolved -> governed structure reached -> provenance materialized -> candidate selected by v2 -> admitted under K=3 reservation -> retained in final evidence.
future_D4_A1.suppression_implementation_mechanism: Evaluation-only overlay / component mask / evaluation parser option; configs/query_expansions.yaml remains byte-identical.
